plugin.name: Brick designer
plugin.description: Build with clamp bricks: pick a brick and a colour, click to place it on the stud grid, stack, turn, delete, and get a parts list. A basic set works offline, more parts load from a free library.

script.brick: Places a brick, a finished model ("model:own-house", "model:6080") or a library part ("ldraw:3001"): position in studs, rotation in quarter turns, height in plates (without it, it rests on what is below) and a colour.
script.wall: Lays a wall of bricks with shifted joints: start corner and length in studs, rows, direction (x or y), colour, and door or window frames set into it.

steps.brick: Click a brick. It now follows your pointer.
steps.place: Click in the 3D view to place it, again for the next one. Esc stops.

selection.hint: Drag a brick to move it. R turns it, Delete removes it, a colour above paints it.

tool.name: Build with bricks
tool.status: Choose a brick in the panel, or drag a placed brick. R: turn, Delete: remove.
tool.statusPlacing: Click to place. R: turn. Page Up/Down: raise or lower. Esc: stop.
tool.statusMoving: Move the brick and let go. R: turn. Page Up/Down: raise or lower.
tool.collides: Another brick is in the way.

online.title: More bricks online
online.intro: Search the common parts of the free {source} library, or type a part number. A part is loaded once and then works offline too.
online.nothing: No part with that name among the common ones.
online.untested: Not tested yet: nobody has run the {source} search with a real key.
online.keyHint: {source} knows every part by name. It only gives the name and number, the shape still comes from the library.
online.keyStored: The key stays in this browser and only goes to the service, in a header.
online.credit: Part shapes: {source} parts library, CC BY.

errors.prepare: The brick could not be prepared.
errors.network: No connection to the service. Check that you are online. Your own bricks work without it.
errors.notFound: The library has no part with this number.
errors.tooLarge: This part is too large to build with.
errors.noGeometry: This part has no shape in the library.
errors.auth: The service did not accept the key.
errors.rate: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.server: The service answered with an error. Try again later.
errors.badNumber: A part number has only letters, digits and dashes.

models.title: Finished models
models.intro: Click a model. It follows your pointer like a brick, and a click places it. Bricks of a model keep their colours.
models.onlineTitle: Whole sets from the LDraw collection (online)
models.fileHint: Many more sets as .mpd or .ldr files:
models.missing: {count} parts of this model are not in the library and were left out.
models.credit: Each brick of a set has one colour. Set models: LDraw model repository, CC BY.

house.name: Brick house
house.description: Walls with door and windows, a roof of slopes, on a baseplate.
